name: Gurgaon (Gurugram)

description.title: Gurugram – The Modern Metropolis
description.short: A modern city of skyscrapers, shopping malls, and lively nightlife, known as a business hub.
description.long: Gurgaon, now called Gurugram, is a modern city of skyscrapers, shopping malls, and lively nightlife. Known as a business hub, it also offers leisure with entertainment zones, golf courses, and restaurants. Blending corporate energy with urban comfort, Gurugram is a fast-paced yet stylish stop near the national capital.
description.history: Gurugram was a small village that transformed into a major business hub and IT center, becoming one of India's most modern cities.
description.overview: A modern metropolis where business meets leisure, offering a fast-paced urban experience with all modern amenities.

name: Panipat

description.title: Panipat – The Historic Weaving City
description.short: The 'City of Weavers,' famed for its handloom industry and historic battles with monuments and forts.
description.long: Panipat, the 'City of Weavers,' is famed for its handloom industry and historic battles. Monuments, forts, and museums highlight its role in India's past. From carpets and textiles to rich heritage, Panipat offers both shopping and history, making it a unique stop for culture and craft lovers.
description.history: Panipat is famous for three historic battles that shaped Indian history. It's also known for its traditional handloom industry and textile manufacturing.
description.overview: A historic city where ancient battles meet traditional craftsmanship, offering unique cultural and shopping experiences.

safetyInformation: Be cautious in busy market areas and handloom workshops.
Respect the historic significance of monuments and forts.
Follow guidelines when visiting museums and heritage sites.
travelTips: Visit historic monuments and forts for historical insights.

Explore museums to learn about the historic battles.

name: Kurukshetra

description.title: Kurukshetra – The Sacred Battlefield
description.short: A sacred land of the Mahabharata, a major pilgrimage destination with Brahma Sarovar and temples.
description.long: Kurukshetra, a sacred land of the Mahabharata, is a major pilgrimage destination. The Brahma Sarovar, temples, and museums narrate its spiritual and historical significance. Visitors come for faith, heritage, and cultural exploration, experiencing a city where mythology, devotion, and history come together in one memorable journey.
description.history: Kurukshetra is the legendary battlefield where the Mahabharata war was fought. It's one of the most sacred places in Hinduism.
description.overview: A sacred city where mythology meets devotion, offering profound spiritual and cultural experiences.

Follow guidelines during religious ceremonies and festivals.

name: Ambala

description.short: A lively twin city known for its cloth market, military cantonment, and transport hubs.
description.long: Ambala, a lively twin city, is known for its cloth market, military cantonment, and transport hubs. With gurudwaras, temples, and a friendly vibe, it offers both heritage and modern conveniences. Ambala serves as a practical stop for travelers, balancing history with a bustling marketplace atmosphere.

name: Karnal

description.title: Karnal – The Agricultural Heart
description.short: Often called the 'Rice Bowl of India,' known for its fertile fields, historic sites, and lakes.
description.long: Karnal, often called the 'Rice Bowl of India,' is known for its fertile fields, historic sites, and lakes. The Karnal Fort and Karna Lake highlight its heritage, while its culinary delights add flavor. Combining agriculture, history, and leisure, Karnal welcomes travelers with both charm and simplicity.
description.history: Karnal is named after Karna from the Mahabharata and is known for its agricultural heritage and historic significance.
description.overview: An agricultural city where farming heritage meets historic charm, offering simple yet authentic experiences.

name: Faridabad

name: Sonipat
